summary: LiveOne, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct issuance of 1,000,000 shares of common stock at $7.50 per share to Broadcast Music, Inc. (BMI Inc.), as designee of Broadcast Music, LLC, to satisfy Slacker, Inc.'s outstanding music royalty payment obligations through March 31, 2027 under existing license agreements. No cash proceeds will be received by LiveOne; the shares offset payments due. The offering price of $7.50 represents a premium over the last reported sale price of $4.81 on April 20, 2026. Closing expected on or about April 24, 2026, subject to customary conditions. BMI Inc. may be deemed an underwriter. This is a routine stock-for-services placement, not a special situation.
